tEn: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
tZh: MiMo-V2.6：将强化学习扩展至自我改进
sEn: MiMo-V2.6 scales reinforcement learning compute across larger batches, diverse agentic environments, and richer grader signals to push omni-modal foundation models toward self-improvement.
sZh: MiMo-V2.6 从更大批次、多样智能体环境与更强评分算力三个维度扩展强化学习算力，推动全模态基础模型迈向自我改进。
absEn: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
absZh: 强化学习（RL）是推动大型基础模型走向自我改进的核心训练范式。本报告介绍 MiMo-V2.6 系列——一个通过扩展 RL 算力来拓展模型智能边界的全模态模型家族。在 RL 之前，我们在广泛的多模态语料上进行中期训练，以提供充足的探索空间，并在预训练的混合 SWA 架构上构建坚实基础，以支撑后续的规模扩展。我们从三个维度扩展 RL 算力：（1）更大的批次与更高的吞吐量，采用异步训练，在最长 1M 的上下文长度下每步消耗 1,568 个样本和 2.7–3.7B token；（2）更多样、更复杂的环境，在多种智能体框架下覆盖代码、通用、视觉与网络领域；（3）更多评分算力，通过分组式智能体评分，为长程任务提供更准确的奖励信号，并引导模型给出更短、更省 token 的解法。为在规模化下保持训练稳定，我们冻结 MoE 路由器，并建立多层防御以抵御奖励黑客。我们还构建了面向混合任务智能体 RL 的基础设施，包括统一的轨迹表示、高并发多框架 rollout、控制面与数据面解耦，以及训练-推理一致性。我们开源了训练动态、RL 环境与 RL 框架，以促进复现及关于规模化 RL 与模型自我改进的进一步研究。

limits.zh: 自我改进主张基于强化学习扩展趋势，未真正展示递归自我改进。

items.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7 \(\sim\) 3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training–inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
items.zh: 强化学习（RL）是推动大型基础模型迈向自我改进的核心训练范式。本报告介绍 MiMo-V2.6 系列——一个全模态模型家族，通过扩展 RL 算力来推进模型智能的前沿。在 RL 之前，我们在广泛的多模态语料上进行中期训练，以提供充足的探索空间，并在预训练的 hybrid-SWA 架构上构建坚实的基础设施，以支撑后续的规模扩展。我们从三个维度扩展 RL 算力：（1）更大的批次与更高的吞吐量，采用异步训练，在上下文窗口长度最高达 1M 时，每步消耗 1,568 个样本和 2.7 \(\sim\) 3.7B 个 token；（2）更多样、更复杂的环境，在混合智能体 harness 下覆盖代码、通用、视觉和网络领域；（3）更多的评分器算力，通过分组式智能体评分，为长时程任务产生更准确的奖励信号，并引导模型给出更短、更 token 高效的解。为在规模扩展下保持训练稳定，我们冻结 MoE 路由器，并建立多层防御以抵御奖励黑客（reward hacking）。我们进一步构建了面向混合任务智能体式 RL 的基础设施，包括统一的轨迹表示、高并发多框架 rollout、解耦的控制面与数据面，以及训练–推理一致性。我们开源了训练动态、RL 环境和 RL 框架，以促进对扩展 RL 与模型自我改进的复现和进一步研究。

items.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions models that expand their capabilities through sustained exploration and feedback. Realizing this vision requires agents, which couple models with interactive environments and thereby supply the multi-step trajectories and feedback signals that self-improvement depends on. Towards this goal, scaling reinforcement learning (RL) on complex agentic tasks thus opens a concrete path. However, realizing this potential faces two major challenges. First, RL for foundation models requires suitable model architectures and a sufficiently rich exploration space for agents. Second, scaling RL requires sophisticated solutions for infrastructure, environments, and graders. In this report, we introduce the MiMo-V2.6 series, including MiMo-V2.6-Pro, a 1.02T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 42B active parameters, and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, a 310B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 15B active parameters, to bridge these gaps, taking a practical step in large-scale RL.
items.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）设想模型通过持续探索和反馈来扩展其能力。实现这一愿景需要智能体，它将模型与交互式环境耦合，从而提供自我改进所依赖的多步轨迹和反馈信号。为此，在复杂智能体任务上扩展强化学习（RL）开辟了一条具体路径。然而，实现这一潜力面临两大挑战。首先，面向基础模型的 RL 需要合适的模型架构和足够丰富的智能体探索空间。其次，扩展 RL 需要针对基础设施、环境和评分器的复杂解决方案。在本报告中，我们介绍 MiMo-V2.6 系列，包括 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（一个 1.02T 参数的混合专家模型，具有 42B 激活参数）和 MiMo-V2.6-Flash（一个 310B 参数的混合专家模型，具有 15B 激活参数），以弥合这些差距，在规模化 RL 方面迈出实践性的一步。

items.en: The architecture, pre-training, and mid-training of MiMo-V2.6 jointly establish a powerful and efficient foundation model. Motivated by the need to preserve global context at low computational cost, MiMo-V2.6 builds a hybrid sparse MoE Transformer backbone that interleaves Local Sliding Window Attention (SWA) with Global Attention (GA), augmented by a lightweight visual encoder and audio encoders. In addition, large-scale pre-training equips the model with extensive knowledge and versatile multimodal understanding across text, audio, and video. We further introduce an agent-centric mid-training phase that expands the exploration space for agentic tasks, enabling the model to discover more effective task-solving trajectories during post-training.
items.zh: MiMo-V2.6 的架构、预训练和中训练共同构建了一个强大且高效的基础模型。出于在低计算成本下保留全局上下文的需求，MiMo-V2.6 构建了一个混合稀疏 MoE Transformer 主干，将局部滑动窗口注意力（SWA）与全局注意力（GA）交错，并辅以轻量级视觉编码器和音频编码器。此外，大规模预训练赋予模型广泛的知识以及跨文本、音频和视频的多功能多模态理解能力。我们进一步引入以智能体为中心的中训练阶段，扩展智能体任务的探索空间，使模型能够在后训练期间发现更有效的任务解决轨迹。

items.en: Next, we scale the RL compute through a systematic, co-designed framework spanning three key components. First, we scale batch size and training throughput through fully asynchronous training, processing thousands of long-horizon rollouts and billions of tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M. Second, we scale the diversity and complexity of RL environments across coding, general, visual, and cybersecurity tasks, using diverse agent harnesses and strengthening safeguards against reward hacking. Varying both the harness and the task improves the model generalization. Third, we introduce groupwise agentic grading to provide more informative reward signals beyond binary test cases. Instead of assigning the same reward to all solutions that pass the test cases, we compare solutions within each group to distinguish problem-solving quality and behaviors. Through our proposed Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS) and Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR), these fine-grained distinctions are converted into more informative learning signals, guiding the model toward more accurate and efficient solutions.
items.zh: 接下来，我们通过一个系统性的、协同设计的框架来扩展 RL 算力，该框架涵盖三个关键组件。首先，我们通过完全异步训练来扩展批量大小和训练吞吐量，在高达 1M 的上下文长度下，每步处理数千个长时程轨迹和数十亿个 token。其次，我们扩展 RL 环境的多样性和复杂性，涵盖编码、通用、视觉和网络安全任务，使用多样化的智能体工具架并加强对奖励黑客的防护。改变工具架和任务都能提高模型的泛化能力。第三，我们引入分组智能体评分，以提供超越二元测试用例的更具信息量的奖励信号。我们不是为所有通过测试用例的解决方案分配相同的奖励，而是在每个组内比较解决方案，以区分问题解决质量和行为。通过我们提出的分组奖励合成（GRS）和分组优势重分配（GAR），这些细粒度的区分被转化为更具信息量的学习信号，引导模型走向更准确和高效的解决方案。

items.en: Realizing these at scale presents both research and engineering challenges for infrastructure. To support flexible agentic interaction scenarios, we design a unified trajectory representation and a penalty mechanism that together refine the learning signal. To handle large training batches, we sustain high-concurrency interaction across diverse agent frameworks through a pool of harnesses, and decouple the control plane from the data plane to buffer and transfer massive trajectories carrying routing and multi-modal payloads. A sample mixing mechanism, working together with dynamic sampling and partial rollout, stabilizes per-task sample composition in train batches. We align the training and inference engines on MoE routing and top-p sampling candidate sets, and optimize both engines for RL workloads.
items.zh: 大规模实现这些对基础设施提出了研究和工程挑战。为了支持灵活的智能体交互场景，我们设计了一种统一的轨迹表示和一种惩罚机制，共同细化学习信号。为了处理大型训练批次，我们通过一个工具架池在多样化的智能体框架之间维持高并发交互，并将控制平面与数据平面解耦，以缓冲和传输携带路由和多模态有效载荷的大规模轨迹。一种样本混合机制，与动态采样和部分展开协同工作，稳定训练批次中每个任务的样本组成。我们在 MoE 路由和 top-p 采样候选集上对齐训练和推理引擎，并针对 RL 工作负载优化两个引擎。

items.en: Scaling RL compute substantially unlocks model potential on both verifiable tasks such as coding and less verifiable tasks such as web development. As shown in Figure 1, both MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash steadily improve their performance across the reported benchmarks as training steps increase. Moreover, these gains are not confined to a single domain, but hold consistently across diverse tasks spanning coding on DeepSWE, general workflows on AutomationBench, visual tasks on MiMo Visual Coding, and cybersecurity on MiMo Cyber Bench. These gains indicate that MiMo-V2.6 is capable of stronger complex problem solving and more reliable performance in daily co-work scenarios, reflecting more general agentic intelligence.
items.zh: 扩展 RL 算力显著释放了模型在可验证任务（如编码）和较难验证任务（如网页开发）上的潜力。如图 1 所示，随着训练步数增加，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 和 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在报告的基准测试中均稳步提升性能。此外，这些增益不仅限于单一领域，而是在多种任务中持续存在，涵盖 DeepSWE 上的编码、AutomationBench 上的通用工作流、MiMo Visual Coding 上的视觉任务以及 MiMo Cyber Bench 上的网络安全。这些增益表明，MiMo-V2.6 能够在日常协作场景中实现更强的复杂问题解决和更可靠的性能，反映出更通用的智能体智能。

items.en: To promote research in agentic RL, we open-source a comprehensive suite covering the key components of the RL development stack, including the lightweight model MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B, curated task environments with verifiers across multiple domains, an end-to-end RL training framework, and a composable mini-harness for flexible agentic interactions. Together, these components provide a unified and accessible platform for studying agentic RL under diverse tasks, environments, and agent configurations, while reducing the engineering barriers to reproducing and extending large-scale RL experiments. Experiments with MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B demonstrate consistent RL gains across diverse tasks and agent harnesses, validating the effectiveness and generality of the proposed suite. We hope this open-source suite can serve as a fair, strong, and reproducible baseline for the community, enabling systematic investigation of agentic RL and advancing research toward recursive self-improvement.
items.zh: 为促进智能体式强化学习（agentic RL）研究，我们开源了一套覆盖强化学习开发栈关键组件的综合套件，包括轻量级模型 MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B、跨多个领域且带有验证器的精选任务环境、端到端强化学习训练框架，以及用于灵活智能体式交互的可组合迷你 harness。这些组件共同提供了一个统一且易用的平台，用于在多样化任务、环境和智能体配置下研究智能体式强化学习，同时降低了复现和扩展大规模强化学习实验的工程门槛。基于 MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B 的实验表明，在不同任务和智能体 harness 上均能获得一致的强化学习增益，验证了所提出套件的有效性与通用性。我们希望这套开源套件能够成为社区公平、强大且可复现的基线，支持对智能体式强化学习进行系统性研究，并推动研究迈向递归自我改进。

items.en: As illustrated in Figure 2, MiMo-V2.6 follows a standard Transformer backbone, augmented with visual and audio encoders connected through lightweight projectors.
items.zh: 如图 2 所示，MiMo-V2.6 采用标准的 Transformer 主干，并通过轻量级投影器连接视觉与音频编码器进行增强。

items.en: The text backbone of MiMo-V2.6 is mainly composed of repeated hybrid blocks that interleave Local Sliding Window Attention (SWA) and Global Attention (GA). It stacks \(M\) hybrid blocks, each structured with \(N\) consecutive SWA blocks followed by a GA block. The only exception is the very first Transformer block, which uses global attention with a dense Feed-Forward Network (FFN) to stabilize early representation learning. The sliding window size \(W\) used in MiMo-V2.6 is \(128\). Both the SWA block and the GA block utilize a sparse MoE FFN without shared experts. MiMo-V2.6 also integrates an SWA and dense FFN based MTP to improve model performance during pre-training. A more comprehensive description of the text backbone architecture can be found in . The model configurations are shown in Table 1.
items.zh: MiMo-V2.6 的文本主干主要由重复的混合块构成，这些混合块交替使用局部滑动窗口注意力机制（SWA）与全局注意力机制（GA）。它堆叠了 \(M\) 个混合块，每个混合块由 \(N\) 个连续的 SWA 块后接一个 GA 块组成。唯一的例外是第一个 Transformer 块，它使用带稠密前馈网络（FFN）的全局注意力机制，以稳定早期的表征学习。MiMo-V2.6 中使用的滑动窗口大小 \(W\) 为 \(128\)。SWA 块与 GA 块均采用不含共享专家的稀疏 MoE FFN。MiMo-V2.6 还集成了基于 SWA 与稠密 FFN 的 MTP，以在预训练期间提升模型性能。关于文本主干架构的更全面描述可见于 。模型配置如表 1 所示。

items.capEn: Figure 2: Overall architecture of MiMo-V2.6. Audio, visual, and text inputs are mapped into a shared token sequence and processed by the MiMo Hybrid-SWA backbone, followed by the language-modeling head and multi-token prediction (MTP) blocks.

items.en: MiMo-ViT adopts a hybrid attention architecture. It replaces the fixed, non-overlapping window attention in MiMo-VL-7B with sink-augmented SWA, enabling information exchange across window boundaries over successive layers and mitigating visual fragmentation. Local SWA layers alternate between row-major and column-major token serialization to support information propagation along both spatial axes. Finally, GA layers are inserted periodically to aggregate global context directly. This design substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution visual processing while achieving performance comparable to GA ViTs. Please refer to [Appendix] for more analysis.
items.zh: MiMo-ViT 采用混合注意力架构。它将 MiMo-VL-7B 中固定的、不重叠的窗口注意力机制替换为带 sink 增强的 SWA，使信息能够在连续层之间跨窗口边界交换，从而缓解视觉碎片化问题。局部 SWA 层在行优先与列优先的 token 序列化方式之间交替，以支持信息沿两个空间轴传播。最后，周期性地插入 GA 层以直接聚合全局上下文。该设计大幅降低了高分辨率视觉处理的计算开销，同时达到与 GA ViT 相当的性能。更多分析请参见[附录]。

items.en: MiMo-V2.6 中的音频编码包含两个阶段：首先使用 Audio Tokenizer 进行音频 tokenization，随后进行 patch encoding。Audio Tokenizer 编码器首先通过一个两层卷积前端处理 log-mel 频谱图，该前端将帧率减半。随后，得到的序列被送入一个采用因果混合注意力架构的 Transformer，该架构交替使用 SWA 层和 GA 层。SWA 层捕获局部时间依赖关系，而 GA 层则聚合整个前序序列的上下文。随后的下采样卷积进一步将帧率减半至 \(25\) Hz，之后一个 20 层残差向量量化器（RVQ）将每一帧表示为 \(20\) 个离散音频 token。Audio Tokenizer 遵循 MiMo-Audio 的训练配方，并在涵盖语音、音乐和其他音频内容的 2000 万小时音频上进行训练。
items.zh: MiMo-V2.6 中的音频编码包含两个阶段：首先使用 Audio Tokenizer 进行音频 tokenization，随后进行 patch encoding。Audio Tokenizer 编码器首先通过一个两层卷积前端处理 log-mel 频谱图，该前端将帧率减半。随后，得到的序列被送入一个采用因果混合注意力架构的 Transformer，该架构交替使用 SWA 层和 GA 层。SWA 层捕获局部时间依赖关系，而 GA 层则聚合整个前序序列的上下文。随后的下采样卷积进一步将帧率减半至 \(25\) Hz，之后一个 20 层残差向量量化器（RVQ）将每一帧表示为 \(20\) 个离散音频 token。Audio Tokenizer 遵循 MiMo-Audio 的训练配方，并在涵盖语音、音乐和其他音频内容的 2000 万小时音频上进行训练。

items.en: 音频 patch 编码器遵循 MiMo-Audio 的架构设计，并与文本主干联合训练。在每个时间步，音频 token 使用独立的嵌入表进行嵌入，每个 RVQ 码本对应一个嵌入表，然后将得到的嵌入求和以形成单帧表示。每四个连续帧被分组为一个音频 patch，并由一个 Transformer 处理，该 Transformer 的注意力机制为限制在该 patch 内的双向自注意力。然后，四个输出表示被拼接并线性投影为单个主干输入嵌入，从而将音频序列速率从 \(25\) Hz 降低到 \(6.25\) Hz。
items.zh: 音频 patch 编码器遵循 MiMo-Audio 的架构设计，并与文本主干联合训练。在每个时间步，音频 token 使用独立的嵌入表进行嵌入，每个 RVQ 码本对应一个嵌入表，然后将得到的嵌入求和以形成单帧表示。每四个连续帧被分组为一个音频 patch，并由一个 Transformer 处理，该 Transformer 的注意力机制为限制在该 patch 内的双向自注意力。然后，四个输出表示被拼接并线性投影为单个主干输入嵌入，从而将音频序列速率从 \(25\) Hz 降低到 \(6.25\) Hz。

items.en: Speculative decoding in MiMo-V2.6 uses a multi-token prediction (MTP) module following the block diffusion design of DFlash. The drafter comprises 5 Transformer layers with dense feed-forward networks. Conditioned on backbone hidden features and a clean anchor token, it predicts 7 subsequent tokens in a single forward pass for parallel verification by the backbone. All draft layers use sliding-window attention (SWA) with grouped queries to limit attention computation and KV-cache size. Tokens attend bidirectionally within their draft block and to at most \(1{,}024\) backbone context positions preceding the anchor.
items.zh: MiMo-V2.6 中的投机解码采用一个多词预测（MTP）模块，其设计遵循 DFlash 的块扩散（block diffusion）方案。该起草器由 5 层 Transformer 组成，并配备稠密前馈网络。它以主干网络的隐藏特征和一个干净的锚点词元为条件，在单次前向传播中预测后续 7 个词元，供主干网络并行验证。所有起草层均使用带分组查询的滑动窗口注意力机制（SWA），以限制注意力计算量和 KV 缓存大小。词元在其起草块内进行双向注意力计算，并且最多关注锚点之前的 \(1{,}024\) 个主干上下文位置。

items.en: The pre-training corpus of MiMo-V2.6 spans text, vision, and audio. The text corpus draws from a broad range of sources, including public web content, books, academic papers, code, and STEM materials. The vision corpus includes image-captioning, grounding, OCR, GUI, conversation, video, and visual-coding data. For audio, we curate diverse, high-quality data at scale and organize the data into three task formats: speech-text interleaving, automatic speech recognition (ASR), and general audio captioning.
items.zh: MiMo-V2.6 的预训练语料涵盖文本、视觉与音频。文本语料来源广泛，包括公开网页内容、书籍、学术论文、代码以及 STEM 材料。视觉语料包括图像描述、定位（grounding）、OCR、GUI、对话、视频以及视觉编程数据。在音频方面，我们大规模构建了多样化的高质量数据，并将数据组织为三种任务格式：语音-文本交错、自动语音识别（ASR）以及通用音频描述。

items.en: We adopt a two-stage pre-training strategy. In the first stage, we train the language backbone on text-only data to establish strong foundational language capabilities. In the second stage, we integrate the backbone with our in-house pre-trained ViT and audio encoder and jointly train the full model on omni-modal data, enabling it to understand images, videos, and audio.
items.zh: 我们采用两阶段预训练策略。第一阶段，我们在纯文本数据上训练语言主干，以建立强大的基础语言能力。第二阶段，我们将主干与自研的预训练 ViT 和音频编码器整合，并在全模态数据上联合训练完整模型，使其能够理解图像、视频与音频。

items.en: We begin pre-training with a context length of 32K tokens and extend it to 256K partway through training. MiMo-V2.6-Flash is trained on 48T tokens, comprising 26T tokens in the text stage and 22T in the omni stage. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is trained on 30T tokens, with 27T and 3T tokens in the two stages, respectively. We employ the AdamW optimizer in the pre-training of MiMo-V2.6.
items.zh: 我们以 32K token 的上下文窗口开始预训练，并在训练中途将其扩展至 256K。MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在 48T token 上训练，其中文本阶段 26T token、全模态阶段 22T token。MiMo-V2.6-Pro 在 30T token 上训练，两个阶段分别为 27T 和 3T token。我们在 MiMo-V2.6 的预训练中采用 AdamW 优化器。

items.en: Pre-training builds broad knowledge and general understanding across text, vision, and audio. Mid-training bridges this general foundation and subsequent large-scale RL by further developing the model's agentic abilities, extending long-context support, and adapting the optimization setup for large-batch training.
items.zh: 预训练在文本、视觉和音频上构建广泛的知识与通用理解。中训练则连接这一通用基础与后续的大规模强化学习（RL）：进一步发展模型的智能体式能力、扩展长上下文支持，并为大 batch 训练调整优化设置。

items.en: To this end, we train the MiMo-V2.6 model series on a diverse, agent-centric data mixture. Its diversity spans both task domains and data modalities, combining realistic agent trajectories across coding, general, visual, and research tasks with high-quality text, repository-level code, and image, video, and audio data. Training proceeds in two stages: we first train with a 256K context length, allocating the majority of compute to this stage, and then extend the context length to 1M in the final stage.
items.zh: 为此，我们在一个多样、以智能体为中心的数据混合上训练 MiMo-V2.6 系列模型。其多样性同时覆盖任务领域与数据模态，将编码、通用、视觉和研究任务中的真实智能体轨迹，与高质量文本、仓库级代码以及图像、视频和音频数据相结合。训练分两个阶段进行：我们首先以 256K 上下文窗口训练，并将大部分算力分配给该阶段；随后在最后阶段将上下文窗口扩展至 1M。

items.en: Our base model was pre-trained with AdamW, but our preliminary experiments showed diminishing optimization efficiency as the batch size increased in mixed-task RL. Unlike AdamW, which adapts parameters element-wise, Muon leverages the matrix structure of hidden weights by orthogonalizing their updates. This matrix-based update retains stronger data efficiency beyond the critical-batch-size regime, making Muon particularly attractive for large-batch training. We therefore switch to a variant of the Muon optimizer, Muown, for the hidden weight matrices during mid-training to prepare the model for subsequent large-batch RL. Muown augments Muon with explicit row-norm control, mitigating spectral-norm drift and reducing sensitivity to weight decay at negligible overhead. Embeddings, the LM head, and the MoE router continue to use AdamW.
items.zh: 我们的基座模型使用 AdamW 预训练，但初步实验表明，在混合任务强化学习中，随着 batch size 增大，优化效率会逐渐下降。与逐元素自适应调整参数的 AdamW 不同，Muon 通过将隐藏权重的更新正交化来利用其矩阵结构。这种基于矩阵的更新在超过临界 batch size 后仍保持更强的数据效率，使 Muon 对大规模 batch 训练尤为有吸引力。因此，在中训练期间，我们对隐藏权重矩阵改用 Muon 优化器的一个变体 Muown，为模型后续的大 batch 强化学习做准备。Muown 在 Muon 基础上增加了显式的行范数控制，以极小的开销缓解谱范数漂移，并降低对权重衰减的敏感性。Embedding、LM head 和 MoE router 仍继续使用 AdamW。

items.en: Prior work reports that switching an Adam-pre-trained model to Muon training can cause optimizer mismatch and degraded performance. Nevertheless, during our mid-training, we observe no loss spike throughout the training process.
items.zh: 已有工作报道，将经 Adam 预训练的模型切换为 Muon 训练可能导致优化器不匹配和性能下降。然而，在我们的中训练过程中，整个训练过程未观察到 loss 尖峰。

items.en: We employ MXFP4 quantization-aware training (QAT) during mid-training, allowing the model to adapt to low-precision computation while preserving model quality.
items.zh: 我们在中训练期间采用 MXFP4 量化感知训练（QAT），使模型能够适应低精度计算，同时保持模型质量。

items.en: In this release, we continue to push the boundaries of post-training algorithms, with a particular focus on scaling RL compute. Following a short supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, we scale RL along three dimensions: training computation (§4.1), environments and agent harnesses (§4.2), and grader computation (§4.3), achieving a fundamental leap in model capabilities.
items.zh: 在本次发布中，我们继续拓展后训练算法的边界，尤其聚焦于扩展强化学习的算力。在短暂的监督微调（SFT）阶段之后，我们沿三个维度扩展强化学习：训练算力（§4.1）、环境与智能体运行框架（§4.2）以及评分器算力（§4.3），从而实现模型能力的根本性跃升。

full.secZh: 4.1 扩展强化学习训练计算

items.en: We scale RL computation across thousands of GPUs in a single run, spending $2.6M and $0.9M on RL post-training for MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, respectively. We use a large training batch: 1,568 prompts with group size \(G{=}16\), so each step rolls out 25K sequences that amount to 2.7B–3.7B training tokens (roughly 110K–150K tokens per sequence). The left panel of Figure 3 shows the benefit of scaling RL computation. The average@3 score on the DeepSWE benchmark rises steadily with cumulative cost for both models: over the course of RL, MiMo-V2.6-Pro improves from \(58.4\) to \(72.6\) and MiMo-V2.6-Flash from \(48.7\) to \(65.7\). The computation splits into three parts: rollout, grading, and training. Such scaling calls for solid infrastructure to keep training efficient and stable.
items.zh: 我们在单次运行中跨数千个 GPU 扩展强化学习计算，为 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 和 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 的强化学习后训练分别花费 260 万美元和 90 万美元。我们使用大批次训练：1,568 个提示，组大小 \(G{=}16\)，因此每一步推出 25K 条序列，总计 27 亿至 37 亿个训练 token（每条序列约 11 万至 15 万 token）。图 3 的左图展示了扩展强化学习计算的好处。两个模型在 DeepSWE 基准上的平均@3 分数随累积成本稳步上升：在强化学习过程中，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 从 \(58.4\) 提升到 \(72.6\)，MiMo-V2.6-Flash 从 \(48.7\) 提升到 \(65.7\)。计算分为三部分：推出、评分和训练。这种扩展需要坚实的基础设施来保持训练高效稳定。

items.en: where \(r\) denotes the importance sampling ratio, \(M\) is the token-level mask, and \(A\) is the advantage. The computation can be decomposed into three parts. The first is rollout: for every prompt \(q\) drawn from the union of task datasets \(\bigcup_{d}\mathcal{D}_{d}\), the rollout policy \(\mu_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}\) generates a group of \(G\) candidate solutions \(\{o_{i}\}\). The second is grading: we invest additional compute in agentic evaluation to distinguish effective solutions and behaviors from flawed ones, beyond what binary test outcomes reveal. These judgments inform the advantages \(A_{i}\), enabling more accurate credit assignment across trajectories. The third is training: the collected tokens update \(\theta\) through the gradient of \(\log\pi_{\theta}(o_{i,t}\mid q,o_{i,<t})\), with prompt-mean aggregation. The right panel of Figure 3 breaks down the cost of MiMo-V2.6-Pro by where the compute goes: rollout consumes 43.8% and training 43.5%, while the grader takes the remaining 12.7%. A large batch draws from diverse RL tasks spanning various environments and harnesses within one run (Section 4.2). We also scale the grader to provide fine-grained learning signals (Section 4.3).
items.zh: 其中 \(r\) 表示重要性采样比，\(M\) 是 token 级掩码，\(A\) 是优势。计算可以分解为三部分。第一部分是推出：对于从任务数据集并集 \(\bigcup_{d}\mathcal{D}_{d}\) 中抽取的每个提示 \(q\)，推出策略 \(\mu_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}\) 生成一组 \(G\) 个候选解 \(\{o_{i}\}\)。第二部分是评分：我们在智能体式评估中投入额外计算，以区分有效解决方案和行为与有缺陷的，超越二元测试结果所揭示的。这些判断为优势 \(A_{i}\) 提供信息，从而在轨迹间实现更准确的信用分配。第三部分是训练：收集的 token 通过 \(\log\pi_{\theta}(o_{i,t}\mid q,o_{i,<t})\) 的梯度更新 \(\theta\)，并采用提示均值聚合。图 3 的右图按计算去向分解了 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 的成本：推出消耗 43.8%，训练消耗 43.5%，而评分器占剩余的 12.7%。大批次在一次运行中从跨各种环境和工具架的多样化强化学习任务中抽取（第 4.2 节）。我们还扩展评分器以提供细粒度的学习信号（第 4.3 节）。

items.en: A large batch is good for scaling out GPUs: rollout parallelizes over sequences and training shards the batch across data-parallel ranks, so throughput grows with the GPU count. With HBM mostly occupied by the running batch, we can keep a high arithmetic intensity to fully use the GPU in rollout. Since rollout and grading have a long tail, we use partial rollout to keep the running batch saturated: when we collect a training batch, we leave the in-flight sequences interrupted and resume them in the next rollout phase. The cost is re-prefill: a continuation must rebuild its KV cache after each policy update, so batch size and partial rollout are chosen together—a large batch amortizes the re-prefill. To support stable RL training, train–inference consistency is ensured by R3 and the replay of top-p sampling candidate sets. To ensure that all samples contribute to training with effective gradients, we incorporate a dynamic sampler to filter groups that are all-pass or all-fail. In multi-task RL, we implement a Sample Mixer to ensure efficient and stable training batch distribution given various rollout durations and pass rates of different tasks. To pack the trajectories from rollout into large training batches (2.7B–3.7B tokens), we decouple the data plane and control plane. The infrastructure behind these designs is described in Section 6.
items.zh: 大批次有利于横向扩展 GPU：推出在序列上并行化，训练在数据并行等级上分片批次，因此吞吐量随 GPU 数量增长。由于 HBM 主要被运行批次占用，我们可以保持高算术强度以在推出中充分利用 GPU。由于推出和评分具有长尾，我们使用部分推出来保持运行批次饱和：当收集训练批次时，我们让进行中的序列中断，并在下一个推出阶段恢复它们。代价是重新预填充：每次策略更新后，延续必须重建其 KV 缓存，因此批次大小和部分推出一起选择——大批次摊销重新预填充。为了支持稳定的强化学习训练，训练-推理一致性由 R3 和 top-p 采样候选集的重放来确保。为了确保所有样本以有效梯度贡献训练，我们加入动态采样器来过滤全通过或全失败的组。在多任务强化学习中，我们实现样本混合器，以在给定不同任务的推出时长和通过率的情况下确保高效稳定的训练批次分布。为了将推出轨迹打包成大批次训练（27 亿至 37 亿 token），我们解耦数据平面和控制平面。这些设计背后的基础设施在第 6 节中描述。

full.secZh: 4.2 扩展强化学习环境与执行框架

items.en: Scaling agentic RL requires diverse environments that reflect real-world tasks, support reproducible execution at training scale, and provide rewards aligned with task objectives. Meeting these requirements jointly is challenging: realistic workflows involve heterogeneous tools and complex state, while automated graders may be incomplete, inconsistent, or vulnerable to exploitation. We therefore invest in large-scale environment synthesis and curation across coding (§4.2.1), general professional workflows (§4.2.2), visual artifacts (§4.2.3), and cybersecurity (§4.2.4), emphasizing supervision quality. This subsection describes how we construct tasks and environments across these domains, the harnesses through which agents interact with them (§4.2.5), and the execution checks, rollout-based audits, and adversarial testing used to improve reward reliability and mitigate reward hacking before and during training (§4.2.6).
items.zh: 扩展智能体式强化学习需要多样化的环境：这些环境应反映真实世界任务、支持在训练规模下可复现地执行，并提供与任务目标一致奖励。同时满足这些要求颇具挑战：真实工作流涉及异构工具与复杂状态，而自动评分器可能不完整、不一致，或易被利用。因此，我们在编码（§4.2.1）、通用专业工作流（§4.2.2）、视觉产物（§4.2.3）和网络安全（§4.2.4）等领域投入大规模环境合成与整理，并强调监督质量。本小节介绍我们如何在上述领域构建任务与环境、智能体与之交互的执行框架（§4.2.5），以及用于在训练前和训练中提升奖励可靠性、缓解奖励黑客行为的执行检查、基于 rollout 的审计和对抗性测试（§4.2.6）。

items.en: Coding tasks are particularly well suited to RL, as candidate solutions can be executed and evaluated through automated tests, providing feedback at scale. However, executable evaluation alone does not guarantee reliable supervision: tests may overlook required behavior, reject valid implementations, or yield inconsistent outcomes across executions. The central challenge is therefore to scale task construction while ensuring that rewards faithfully reflect task correctness. Motivated by this, we devote substantial effort to building a scalable synthesis and curation pipeline for coding-agent tasks, with an emphasis on the accuracy and robustness of supervision. Figure 4 summarizes the task synthesis pathways and the checks used to assess supervision accuracy and robustness.
items.zh: 编码任务特别适合强化学习（RL），因为候选解决方案可以通过自动化测试执行和评估，从而大规模提供反馈。然而，仅靠可执行评估并不能保证可靠的监督：测试可能忽略所需行为、拒绝有效实现，或在多次执行中产生不一致的结果。因此，核心挑战在于扩展任务构建规模，同时确保奖励忠实反映任务正确性。为此，我们投入大量精力构建可扩展的编码智能体任务合成与整理流程，重点在于监督的准确性和鲁棒性。图 4 总结了任务合成路径以及用于评估监督准确性和鲁棒性的检查。

items.en: We scale task construction through five complementary synthesis pathways, designed to cover heterogeneous programming languages, development settings, and task horizons. First, in GitHub-based synthesis, we collect pull requests and their associated issues and apply heuristic and model-assisted filters to remove duplicate, malformed, or non-reproducible candidates. When a pull request is linked to an issue that provides a sufficiently complete description of the intended change, we use the issue as the task specification. Otherwise, an LLM reconstructs an issue-style specification from the reference patch and the surrounding repository context, while being explicitly instructed to omit implementation-specific details that could reveal the solution. Second, to capture everyday development workflows, including interactive “vibe coding” scenarios, we collect real-world development requests contributed by employees within our organization. These requests cover common activities such as feature implementation, refactoring, debugging, and repository maintenance, for which agents generate and implement test cases that operationalize the requested behavior. Third, specification-driven tasks emphasize code generation under detailed, multi-constraint requirements, allowing us to evaluate whether models can faithfully translate complex specifications into executable implementations. Fourth, in source-code-driven synthesis, we use CodeMidas to derive tasks from functionality implemented in existing codebases. Agents identify candidate functionality and translate its observable behavior into task specifications and executable environments, this pathway enables scalable task construction across diverse repositories without requiring issues, pull requests, or other development artifacts. For long-horizon software-engineering tasks, agents iteratively elaborate task requirements, expand the scope of the required changes, introduce dependencies across components, and construct tests that exercise the resulting multi-step behavior. We also include and filter samples from public sources and licensed data vendors to further enrich the task distribution. Collectively, these pathways produce tasks spanning a broad range of programming languages, development contexts, implementation complexities, and task horizons.
items.zh: 我们通过五种互补的合成路径来扩展任务构建，旨在覆盖异构的编程语言、开发环境和任务范围。首先，在基于 GitHub 的合成中，我们收集拉取请求及其关联的问题，并应用启发式和模型辅助的过滤器来移除重复、格式错误或不可复现的候选。当拉取请求链接到提供了足够完整预期变更描述的问题时，我们使用该问题作为任务规范。否则，由 LLM 从参考补丁和周围仓库上下文重建问题风格的规范，同时明确指示其省略可能泄露解决方案的实现细节。其次，为了捕捉日常开发工作流，包括交互式“氛围编码”场景，我们收集组织内员工贡献的真实世界开发请求。这些请求涵盖功能实现、重构、调试和仓库维护等常见活动，智能体为这些活动生成并实现测试用例，将请求的行为操作化。第三，规范驱动的任务强调在详细的多约束要求下生成代码，使我们能够评估模型是否能够将复杂规范忠实转化为可执行实现。第四，在源代码驱动的合成中，我们使用 CodeMidas 从现有代码库中实现的功能派生任务。智能体识别候选功能，并将其可观察行为转化为任务规范和可执行环境，该路径使得跨多样仓库的可扩展任务构建成为可能，而无需问题、拉取请求或其他开发工件。对于长周期软件工程任务，智能体迭代地细化任务需求、扩展所需变更的范围、引入组件间的依赖关系，并构建测试以检验由此产生的多步行为。我们还包含并过滤来自公共来源和授权数据供应商的样本，以进一步丰富任务分布。总体而言，这些路径产生的任务涵盖广泛的编程语言、开发背景、实现复杂性和任务范围。

items.en: We align the behavioral scope of each task specification with that of its unit tests. The goal is to accept implementations that satisfy the specification and reject those that violate it, without requiring incidental details of the reference implementation. We review tasks for insufficient coverage and overly restrictive checks. In particular, tests that enforce requirements absent from the specification are revised or removed. As inspection alone may miss discrepancies between specifications and tests, we further assess their alignment through rollout-based auditing. Each task is attempted four times by a coding agent. An auditing agent receives all four rollouts in a shared workspace containing the problem statement, tests, reference patch, and each rollout’s submitted patch, test output, and full conversation log. The auditor first articulates what a correct solution requires and assesses whether the tests capture those requirements. It then evaluates each submitted solution against the specification using its patch and conversation log, and compares this assessment with the observed reward. A passing solution judged incorrect is flagged as a potential false positive, suggesting incomplete verification. A failing solution judged correct is flagged as a potential false negative, suggesting overly restrictive tests or execution failures. These disagreements identify tasks requiring further review and provide concrete evidence of possible mismatches between the intended behavior and the implemented verification.
items.zh: 我们将每个任务规范的行为范围与其单元测试的行为范围对齐。目标是接受满足规范的实现，拒绝违反规范的实现，而不要求参考实现的偶然细节。我们审查任务是否覆盖不足和检查过于严格。特别是，强制执行规范中未出现要求的测试会被修改或移除。由于仅靠检查可能遗漏规范与测试之间的差异，我们进一步通过基于 rollout 的审计来评估它们的一致性。每个任务由编码智能体尝试四次。审计智能体在一个共享工作区中接收所有四次 rollout，该工作区包含问题陈述、测试、参考补丁以及每个 rollout 提交的补丁、测试输出和完整对话日志。审计员首先阐明正确解决方案的要求，并评估测试是否捕捉到这些要求。然后，它使用提交的补丁和对话日志，根据规范评估每个提交的解决方案，并将此评估与观察到的奖励进行比较。通过但被判定为不正确的解决方案被标记为潜在假阳性，表明验证不完整。失败但被判定为正确的解决方案被标记为潜在假阴性，表明测试过于严格或执行失败。这些分歧识别出需要进一步审查的任务，并提供具体证据表明预期行为与实施的验证之间可能存在不匹配。

items.en: We check reward stability through repeated execution. For those tasks with reference patch, we ensure fail-to-pass (F2P) tests must fail and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests must pass before applying the reference patch; after the patch, both must pass. We require these outcomes to remain stable across eight reruns, screening for flaky tests and environment-induced reward fluctuations. We also reuse the previous rollout pipeline to collect agent trajectories to investigate potential reward hacking. The submitted patches and conversation logs provide evidence of how agents obtained their rewards, helping identify unintended shortcuts or exploitation of the environment and evaluation process. These checks complement the assessment of solution correctness and inform the broader reward-hacking mitigation procedures described below.
items.zh: 我们通过重复执行来检查奖励稳定性。对于有参考补丁的任务，我们确保在应用参考补丁之前，失败转通过（F2P）测试必须失败，通过转通过（P2P）测试必须通过；应用补丁后，两者都必须通过。我们要求这些结果在八次重跑中保持稳定，以筛查不稳定的测试和环境引起的奖励波动。我们还重用之前的 rollout 管道来收集智能体轨迹，以调查潜在的奖励黑客行为。提交的补丁和对话日志提供了智能体如何获得奖励的证据，有助于识别意外的捷径或对环境及评估过程的利用。这些检查补充了对解决方案正确性的评估，并为下文描述的更广泛的奖励黑客缓解程序提供信息。

items.en: Together, these procedures support the construction of a diverse coding-task corpus under a consistent standard of supervision quality. Specification–test alignment targets the fidelity of the reward signal, repeated execution checks its stability, and rollout-based auditing probes whether it agrees with an independent assessment of solution correctness. Our objective is to make this combination scalable, so that RL training can benefit from broad task coverage while encouraging agents to satisfy the intended requirements rather than exploit gaps in evaluation.
items.zh: 总之，这些程序支持在一致的监督质量标准下构建多样化的编码任务语料库。规范-测试对齐针对奖励信号的保真度，重复执行检查其稳定性，基于 rollout 的审计探究其是否与解决方案正确性的独立评估一致。我们的目标是使这种组合具有可扩展性，以便 RL 训练能够受益于广泛的任务覆盖，同时鼓励智能体满足预期要求，而不是利用评估中的漏洞。

items.en: We extend agent capabilities to real-world professional workflows across diverse domains, whose workflows require agents to analyze heterogeneous documents, use specialized software, and produce deliverables that meet domain-specific standards. We synthesize environments that support such workflows, then construct challenging tasks with verifiable outcomes. Figure 5 summarizes this pipeline, including environment construction, task synthesis, and iterative rubric refinement.
items.zh: 我们将智能体能力扩展到跨多个领域的真实专业工作流中，这些工作流要求智能体分析异构文档、使用专用软件，并产出符合领域特定标准的交付物。我们合成支持此类工作流的环境，然后构建具有可验证结果的挑战性任务。图 5 总结了这一流程，包括环境构建、任务合成和评分标准（rubric）的迭代优化。

items.en: A general-agent environment typically consists of a workspace and a set of software tools, accessible through interfaces such as MCP, APIs, CLIs, and GUIs. Our design balances realism with the requirements of large-scale RL: files, software behavior, and underlying data should reflect professional practice, while execution must remain local and environments must be easy to reset. We therefore collect real-world files for direct inclusion or as references for synthesis, and use an automated multi-agent workflow to build local software mocks that reproduce supported operations, state changes, output formats, and error responses. Tools that already operate without external services are integrated directly. All state is stored locally, and each rollout runs in an isolated sandbox that can be restored to a fixed initial state. This avoids network variability and service limits while supporting reproducible execution.
items.zh: 通用智能体环境通常由一个工作区和一组软件工具组成，可通过 MCP、API、CLI 和 GUI 等接口访问。我们的设计在真实性与大规模强化学习（RL）的需求之间取得平衡：文件、软件行为和底层数据应反映专业实践，同时执行必须保持在本地，且环境必须易于重置。因此，我们收集真实文件，用于直接纳入或作为合成参考，并使用自动化的多智能体工作流构建本地软件模拟（mock），以复现所支持的操作、状态变化、输出格式和错误响应。对于已经无需外部服务即可运行的工具，我们直接集成。所有状态都存储在本地，每次 rollout 都在一个可恢复到固定初始状态的隔离沙箱中运行。这避免了网络波动和服务限制，同时支持可复现的执行。

items.en: To assemble these components into coherent scenarios, a planning agent specifies the workspace structure, selects appropriate tools, and plans file and database contents. Web search grounds the plan in real-world information, while relationships across files and between files and database records support subsequent multi-hop reasoning and cross-validation. Multiple agents then generate files and populate databases in parallel, following the shared plan and each mock's data specification. A review agent checks individual artifacts and global consistency, including entity names, numerical reconciliation, timelines, and references. Iterative repair resolves inconsistencies before task construction. The workspace and tool configuration vary by scenario, so each environment reflects the relevant working practices without requiring every available file type or software interface.
items.zh: 为了将这些组件组装成连贯的场景，规划智能体指定工作区结构、选择合适的工具，并规划文件和数据库内容。网络搜索使规划建立在真实世界信息之上，而文件之间以及文件与数据库记录之间的关系则支持后续的多跳推理和交叉验证。随后，多个智能体按照共享的规划和每个 mock 的数据规范并行生成文件并填充数据库。审查智能体检查单个产物和全局一致性，包括实体名称、数值核对、时间线和引用。在任务构建之前，迭代修复会解决不一致之处。工作区和工具配置因场景而异，因此每个环境都反映相关的工作实践，而不要求具备所有可用的文件类型或软件接口。

items.en: We survey common professional tasks and combine and generalize them into seed tasks. An agent explores each environment and uses these seeds to construct tasks suited to its contents and tools. Task completion is evaluated using atomic, binary rubric items: code-based checks verify deterministic properties, such as database values and deliverable formats, while LLM-based checks assess more open-ended content. For LLM-based items, agreement across repeated judgments by the same model and across different judge models helps identify ambiguity.
items.zh: 我们调研常见的专业任务，并将它们组合、泛化为种子任务。智能体探索每个环境，并利用这些种子构建适合其内容和工具的任务。任务完成情况通过原子化的二元评分项进行评估：基于代码的检查验证确定性属性，例如数据库值和交付物格式，而基于 LLM 的检查则评估更开放的内容。对于基于 LLM 的评分项，同一模型重复判断之间以及不同评判模型之间的一致性有助于识别歧义。

items.en: Consistency alone does not establish that rubrics capture task completion. We therefore collect rollouts from models with different capability levels and have a review agent examine their trajectories, execution results, and rubric judgments. The reviewer revises overly restrictive criteria that reject valid solutions and overly permissive criteria that accept incomplete ones. To test resistance to reward hacking, we include negative checks for unintended changes to unrelated files or databases and construct adversarial solutions that appear correct without actually solving the task. During RL, a self-hosted MiMo-V2.6-SFT model serves as the grader to support stable scoring. This process yields thousands of environments and diverse, verifiable tasks, which we combine with other tasks for RL training.
items.zh: 仅凭一致性并不能证明评分标准捕捉到了任务完成情况。因此，我们收集来自不同能力水平模型的 rollout，并让审查智能体检查它们的轨迹、执行结果和评分判断。审查者会修改过于严格、会拒绝有效解决方案的标准，以及过于宽松、会接受不完整解决方案的标准。为了测试对奖励黑客（reward hacking）的抵抗力，我们加入负向检查，以检测对无关文件或数据库的非预期更改，并构建看似正确但实际并未解决任务的对抗性解决方案。在 RL 期间，一个自托管的 MiMo-V2.6-SFT 模型充当评分器，以支持稳定的评分。这一过程产生了数千个环境和多样化的可验证任务，我们将它们与其他任务结合用于 RL 训练。

items.en: To empower agents to shape the digital world through creative expression and precise visual control, we curate a diverse suite of visual tasks in which agents work with a broad range of artifacts, such as websites, interactive applications, games, 3D scenes, slides, SVG, videos and Figma designs. We organize these tasks into two complementary categories: open-ended design and high-fidelity visual replication. Together, they develop the model's ability to produce reliable implementations with strong aesthetic quality and precise visual control.
items.zh: 为使智能体能够通过创造性表达与精确的视觉控制来塑造数字世界，我们精心设计了一套多样化的视觉任务，智能体在其中处理广泛类型的产物，例如网站、交互式应用、游戏、3D 场景、幻灯片、SVG、视频和 Figma 设计。我们将这些任务组织为两个互补的类别：开放式设计与高保真视觉复现。二者共同培养模型产出可靠实现、兼具出色美学质量与精确视觉控制的能力。

items.en: Open-ended design seeks to produce aesthetically compelling visual artifacts that satisfy user intent. The diversity of valid creative solutions makes aesthetic quality difficult to capture through fixed rules alone. We therefore combine pointwise and groupwise grading to establish consistent quality standards while rewarding relative improvements in aesthetic quality. Specifically, we first iteratively refine pointwise rubrics for runtime correctness, instruction adherence, layout integrity, and basic aesthetic quality. Once these rubrics stabilize, we introduce groupwise grading that jointly compares the rendered artifacts within each rollout group for the same query, identifying clearly stronger and weaker candidates and assigning rewards accordingly.
items.zh: 开放式设计旨在产出满足用户意图、具有美学吸引力的视觉产物。有效创意方案的多样性使得仅靠固定规则难以刻画美学质量。因此，我们结合逐点评分与组内评分，以建立一致的质量标准，同时对美学质量的相对提升给予奖励。具体而言，我们首先迭代细化针对运行时正确性、指令遵循、布局完整性和基本美学质量的逐点评分细则。待这些细则稳定后，我们引入组内评分，对同一查询下每个 rollout 组内渲染出的产物进行联合比较，识别出明显更强与更弱的候选，并据此分配奖励。

items.en: High-fidelity visual replication aims to faithfully reproduce a specified visual target. Compared to open-ended design, the explicit reference enables more direct evaluation of visual fidelity. We grade these tasks primarily through rule-based similarity metrics, such as pixel-level similarity between rendered artifacts and their references, supplemented by LLM-based judging for holistic visual assessment. Together, these signals support effective scaling of reinforcement learning on visual replication tasks.
items.zh: 高保真视觉复现旨在忠实复现指定的视觉目标。与开放式设计相比，明确的参考对象使得对视觉保真度的评估更为直接。我们主要通过基于规则的相似度指标对这些任务进行评分，例如渲染产物与其参考之间的像素级相似度，并辅以基于 LLM 的评判以进行整体视觉评估。这些信号共同支撑了强化学习在视觉复现任务上的有效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

items.en: We train cyber agents with RL on real-world vulnerability reproduction: given a project and a target bug, the agent must construct an input that triggers it. This foundational offensive-security skill underlies exploit development, privilege escalation, and CTF challenges. It is also well suited to RL at scale: OSS-Fuzz supplies tens of thousands of manually confirmed instances, a volume unmatched by other security tasks. The difficulty is not triggering a crash, since complex C/C++ projects expose dozens of reachable crash paths, but triggering the specific vulnerability described. Verification must therefore separate the intended bug from unrelated crashes, and because it doubles as the RL reward, it must be accurate, deterministic, and cheap.
items.zh: 我们使用强化学习在真实世界的漏洞复现任务上训练网络安全智能体：给定一个项目和目标漏洞，智能体必须构造一个能触发该漏洞的输入。这一基础攻击性安全技能是漏洞利用开发、权限提升和 CTF 挑战的基础。它也适合大规模强化学习：OSS-Fuzz 提供了数万个手动确认的实例，这一数量是其他安全任务无法比拟的。难点不在于触发崩溃，因为复杂的 C/C++项目会暴露数十条可达的崩溃路径，而在于触发所描述的特定漏洞。因此，验证必须将目标漏洞与无关崩溃区分开，并且由于它同时作为强化学习的奖励，它必须准确、确定且廉价。

items.en: Existing oracles fall short. Fix-binary differential testing, as used in CyberGym, accepts a PoC that crashes the vulnerable binary but not the patched one; an incomplete patch rejects correct PoCs, and unrelated changes between the two commits flip verdicts for reasons unconnected to the bug. Either error corrupts the training gradient. LLM-based judging returns different verdicts for the same PoC across runs and cannot serve as a stable reward. We instead extract two attributes from the ground-truth sanitizer (ASan/MSan/UBSan) report: the vulnerability type (e.g., heap-buffer-overflow) and the crash location (the topmost project-level stack frame). A PoC is accepted iff its crash matches both under rule-based string matching, which is deterministic, reproducible, and computationally trivial. The task description is derived from the same report, stating the exact type and function in which the crash must occur, so description and verification share a single source of truth; CyberGym’s LLM-generated descriptions, by contrast, are often too broad (e.g., “buffer overflow in libxml2”) or simply wrong.
items.zh: 现有的判定标准存在不足。CyberGym 中使用的修复二进制差分测试接受一个能使存在漏洞的二进制崩溃但不能使修补后的二进制崩溃的 PoC；不完整的补丁会拒绝正确的 PoC，而两个提交之间的无关更改会因与漏洞无关的原因翻转判定结果。任一错误都会破坏训练梯度。基于 LLM 的评判对同一个 PoC 在不同运行中返回不同的判定，无法作为稳定的奖励。相反，我们从真实的标准检查器（ASan/MSan/UBSan）报告中提取两个属性：漏洞类型（例如，堆缓冲区溢出）和崩溃位置（最顶层的项目级堆栈帧）。当且仅当 PoC 的崩溃在基于规则的字符串匹配下同时匹配这两个属性时，才被接受，这种匹配是确定性的、可复现的且计算上微不足道。任务描述源自同一报告，说明崩溃必须发生的准确类型和函数，因此描述和验证共享单一事实来源；相比之下，CyberGym 的 LLM 生成的描述通常过于宽泛（例如，“libxml2 中的缓冲区溢出”）或完全错误。

items.en: For each vulnerability we check out the source at the reported commit, build the fuzzing harness, and give the agent the complete runtime environment: full source plus the compiled harness binary. CyberGym withholds the binary, restricting agents to source-only analysis; providing it mirrors real vulnerability analysis, where a researcher runs the target under a debugger, inspects memory, and crafts mutations from runtime observations.
items.zh: 对于每个漏洞，我们检出报告提交处的源代码，构建模糊测试框架，并为智能体提供完整的运行时环境：完整源代码加上编译后的框架二进制文件。CyberGym 不提供二进制文件，限制智能体仅进行源代码分析；提供二进制文件反映了真实的漏洞分析，研究人员在调试器下运行目标，检查内存，并根据运行时观察构造变异。

items.en: Agent harnesses differ in module design and are selected or built to meet different application needs. Models must therefore adapt to diverse interaction mechanisms, including those of harnesses unseen during training, making cross-harness generalization an important capability.
items.zh: 智能体执行框架在模块设计上各不相同，且是为满足不同应用需求而选择或构建的。因此，模型必须适应多样的交互机制，包括训练期间未曾见过的执行框架的交互机制，这使得跨执行框架泛化成为一项重要能力。

items.en: Training exclusively within a single harness may couple task-solving strategies to harness-specific implementations and limit transfer. We therefore treat harness diversity as an additional training dimension alongside diversity in tasks and environments. A natural approach is to train on several production harnesses such as MiMo Code and Codex. However, this is a poor fit for RL in practice. First, production harnesses wrap the agent loop with engineering safeguards and multi-step workflows, and steer the model with numerous constraint and instruction prompts. These extras fall outside the task-completion reward signal, making credit assignment unreliable and leaving reward-unmeasured requirements to simply be ignored. Second, their modules are tightly coupled rather than independently configurable, so one cannot vary a single interaction mechanism in isolation or assemble diversity by controlled recombination.
items.zh: 仅在单一执行框架内训练，可能使任务求解策略与特定执行框架的实现相耦合，从而限制迁移。因此，我们将执行框架的多样性视为与任务多样性和环境多样性并列的额外训练维度。一种自然的做法是在 MiMo Code 和 Codex 等多个生产级执行框架上进行训练。然而，在实践中这并不适合强化学习。首先，生产级执行框架用工程化防护措施和多步工作流包裹智能体循环，并通过大量约束与指令提示引导模型。这些额外内容落在任务完成奖励信号之外，使信用分配不可靠，并导致未被奖励衡量的要求被直接忽略。其次，它们的模块紧密耦合而非可独立配置，因此无法单独改变某一交互机制，也无法通过受控重组来组合多样性。

items.en: To this end, we propose multi-harness training with carefully designed mini-harnesses. All mini-harnesses start from the same minimal agent loop, which already includes the components needed for task completion—system prompt, tools, and context management. These modules stay minimal and decoupled, so implementations can be freely recombined and harness expansion remains controllable, safe, and clean. We then derive diverse, task-adapted mini-harness configurations for Code, General, Visual, and Cyber. The resulting training distribution is diverse yet controllable, supporting analysis of individual harness mechanisms and encouraging transferable task-solving strategies.
items.zh: 为此，我们提出使用精心设计的迷你执行框架进行多执行框架训练。所有迷你执行框架都从同一个最小智能体循环出发，该循环已包含完成任务所需的组件——系统提示、工具和上下文管理。这些模块保持最小化且解耦，因此实现可以自由重组，执行框架的扩展也保持可控、安全且简洁。随后，我们为 Code、General、Visual 和 Cyber 推导出多样且适配任务的迷你执行框架配置。由此得到的训练分布既多样又可控，支持对单个执行框架机制进行分析，并鼓励形成可迁移的任务求解策略。

items.en: RL relies on rewards to measure task success, but agents can sometimes earn high rewards by exploiting the environment or the evaluation process. This behavior, known as reward hacking, can be reinforced during training, increasing scores without improving task performance. For common coding agent tasks like repository-repair, a recurring failure mode is solution leakage: agents obtain a published fix beyond the intended task context and use it to construct a patch. Table 2 links each task request to the agent's stated intent and subsequent action across five repositories. Such behavior can satisfy the test-based reward without demonstrating that the agent derived the repair from the bug report and the assigned checkout. Following this, we introduce our mitigation combining mid-training alignment data with RL environment preparation, adversarial screening, and auditing throughout training.
items.zh: 强化学习依赖奖励来衡量任务是否成功，但智能体有时会通过利用环境或评估过程来获取高奖励。这种行为被称为奖励黑客行为（reward hacking），它可能在训练过程中被强化，从而在不提升任务表现的情况下提高分数。对于仓库修复（repository-repair）这类常见的编程智能体任务，一种反复出现的失败模式是解法泄漏（solution leakage）：智能体获取了超出预期任务上下文的已发布修复，并用它来构造补丁。表 2 在五个仓库上，将每个任务请求与智能体所声明的意图及后续动作对应起来。此类行为可以满足基于测试的奖励，却无法证明智能体是从缺陷报告和指定的代码检出（checkout）中推导出修复的。为此，我们提出了相应的缓解措施，将中期训练对齐数据与 RL 环境准备、对抗性筛查以及贯穿训练全程的审计相结合。

items.en: In early experiments, we observed a tendency toward reward hacking in MiMo. To mitigate this behavior, we synthesized a set of training examples from these cases and included them in mid-training. For each case, MiMo reflects on the faulty reasoning, revises the relevant turn, and continues with actions grounded in the task specification. The revised reasoning keeps the original error recognizable and makes the correction explicit. We found that adding these examples improved the model's alignment.
items.zh: 在早期实验中，我们观察到 MiMo 存在奖励黑客行为的倾向。为缓解这一行为，我们从这些案例中合成了一组训练样本，并将其纳入中期训练。对于每个案例，MiMo 会反思错误的推理，修正相关轮次，并继续执行以任务规范为依据的动作。修正后的推理保留了原始错误以便识别，同时使纠正过程显式化。我们发现，加入这些样本提升了模型的对齐程度。

items.en: In coding tasks, agents may pass tests by recovering leaked solutions from the environment or retrieving existing solutions over the network. Building a project with the reference patch applied during environment construction can leave behind artifacts that reveal the solution. We therefore remove build logs, verifier outputs, residual patches, and project-generated binaries or bytecode that could expose it. We also clean caches that may contain solution information, including those outside the repository, while preserving third-party dependencies needed for offline rebuilding. For every task, we retain Git history up to and including the base commit, removing later commits and their associated references. We enforce container-level network isolation to restrict access to upstream fixes and alternative package versions that may contain the solution. These safeguards are accompanied by explicit instructions against retrieving existing solutions or bypassing the required implementation.
items.zh: 在编程任务中，智能体可能通过从环境中恢复泄漏的解法，或通过网络检索已有解法来通过测试。在环境构建期间应用参考补丁来构建项目，可能会留下暴露解法的产物。因此，我们移除构建日志、验证器输出、残留补丁，以及可能暴露解法的项目生成二进制文件或字节码。我们还清理可能包含解法信息的缓存，包括仓库之外的缓存，同时保留离线重建所需的第三方依赖。对于每个任务，我们保留截至并包含基础提交（base commit）的 Git 历史，移除之后的提交及其相关引用。我们实施容器级网络隔离，以限制对上游修复以及可能包含解法的其他包版本的访问。这些防护措施还配有明确指令，禁止检索已有解法或绕过所要求的实现。

items.en: A dedicated hack agent then probes the prepared environments for remaining leaks and exploitable weaknesses. We guide its search with examples from early experiments, including recovering solutions from cached artifacts or preinstalled copies of the target project. The agent checks these known routes while searching for new ones. It uncovered many exploit paths that we had not observed during training and that our existing cleanup procedures did not cover. We use these findings to refine cleanup and access restrictions, then rerun the hack agent on the updated environments. These subsequent checks repeatedly exposed further weaknesses, requiring additional rounds of cleanup and testing. We continued this process until the hack agent could no longer find a successful exploit in any of the environments.
items.zh: 随后，一个专门的 hack 智能体（hack agent）会探测已准备好的环境，寻找残留泄漏和可利用的弱点。我们用早期实验中的示例来引导其搜索，包括从缓存产物或目标项目的预装副本中恢复解法。该智能体在检查这些已知路径的同时，也在搜索新的路径。它发现了许多我们在训练期间未曾观察到、且现有清理流程未能覆盖的利用路径。我们利用这些发现来改进清理和访问限制，然后在更新后的环境中重新运行 hack 智能体。这些后续检查反复暴露出更多弱点，需要额外多轮清理和测试。我们持续这一过程，直到 hack 智能体无法在任何环境中找到成功的利用路径为止。

items.en: We regularly audit agent trajectories offline for reward hacking throughout training. As the policy evolves, it may discover shortcuts that were not found during adversarial screening. We use these observations to identify weaknesses in the environments and guide further cleanup and access restrictions. Alongside these offline audits, the groupwise agentic grader (Section 4.3.2) sets the effective reward of confirmed hacking trajectories to zero before recomputing group statistics and advantages. With this correction in place, the logged confirmed-hack share remains below \(2\)% throughout the whole training process for both MiMo-V2.6-Flash and MiMo-V2.6-Pro (Figure 6).
items.zh: 我们在整个训练过程中定期离线审计智能体的轨迹，以检查奖励黑客行为。随着策略的演化，它可能发现对抗性筛查中未能发现的捷径。我们利用这些观察来识别环境中的弱点，并指导进一步的清理和访问限制。除这些离线审计外，分组式智能体评分器（groupwise agentic grader，第 4.3.2 节）会在重新计算组统计量和优势之前，将已确认的 hack 轨迹的有效奖励设为零。在此修正下，对于 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 和 MiMo-V2.6-Pro，整个训练过程中记录的已确认 hack 占比始终低于 \(2\)%（图 6）。

(a) Environment preparation and iterative hack-agent screening before training, while offline trajectory audits monitor hacking behaviors throughout training. Findings from both stages are used for environment improvements. (b) Top: the fraction of

items.en: For code agent tasks, binary test rewards provide a scalable correctness signal but do not distinguish implementation quality or problem-solving behavior among passing solutions. We use two complementary methods on distinct subsets of these tasks. Groupwise Reward Synthesis (GRS) is used for a subset of high-pass-rate tasks. It compares multiple offline rollouts to construct task-specific rubrics, which are reused during training to score individual rollouts and combine their quality scores with test rewards. For all the remaining code agent tasks, we rely primarily on Groupwise Advantage Redistribution (GAR). Its online agentic grader jointly examines successful and failed trajectories within each mixed-outcome group, ranks passing solutions, and redistributes positive advantage toward higher-quality passing trajectories. Figure 7 summarizes both workflows.
items.zh: 对于代码智能体任务，二元测试奖励提供了可扩展的正确性信号，但无法区分通过解之间的实现质量或问题求解行为。我们在这些任务的不同子集上使用两种互补的方法。分组式奖励合成（Groupwise Reward Synthesis，GRS）用于高通过率任务的一个子集。它比较多个离线 rollout 以构建任务特定的评分细则（rubrics），这些细则在训练期间被复用以对单个 rollout 打分，并将其质量分数与测试奖励相结合。对于其余所有代码智能体任务，我们主要依赖分组式优势重分配（Groupwise Advantage Redistribution，GAR）。其在线智能体式评分器联合检查每个混合结果组内的成功与失败轨迹，对通过解进行排序，并将正优势重新分配给质量更高的通过轨迹。图 7 总结了这两种工作流程。

full.secZh: 4.3.1 分组奖励合成（GRS，离线评分标准）

items.en: For each selected task, we collect multiple offline rollouts and ask an agent to study them together with the task specification and repository. Comparing these attempts exposes different solution approaches, recurring mistakes, and useful behaviors that may be distributed across several trajectories. The agent turns this analysis into two sets of criteria: solution rubrics, which assess the resulting implementation, and behavior rubrics, which assess how the agent approaches and verifies its work.
items.zh: 对于每个选定的任务，我们收集多条离线 rollout，并让一个智能体结合任务说明与代码仓库对它们进行研究。比较这些尝试可以揭示不同的解法、反复出现的错误，以及可能分散在若干条轨迹中的有用行为。智能体将这一分析转化为两组标准：**解法评分标准**（solution rubrics），用于评估最终实现；以及**行为评分标准**（behavior rubrics），用于评估智能体如何着手并验证其工作。

items.en: Solution rubrics describe task-relevant properties of a good implementation, including satisfaction of the requirements, appropriate handling of edge cases, and changes consistent with the surrounding codebase. Behavior rubrics describe observable practices that support reliable problem solving, such as gathering relevant evidence and checking the effects of code changes. We seek criteria that distinguish meaningful differences in quality while allowing different valid approaches to the task.
items.zh: 解法评分标准描述一个良好实现中与任务相关的属性，包括是否满足需求、是否恰当处理边界情况，以及与周边代码库保持一致的改动。行为评分标准描述支持可靠问题解决的可观察实践，例如收集相关证据、检查代码改动的效果。我们寻求能够区分质量上实质性差异、同时允许对任务采用不同有效方法的标准。

items.en: The sampled rollouts inform rubric construction, but the criteria are grounded in the task itself. A useful behavior may appear in only one attempt, and a requirement supported by the task may be absent from every observed solution. The agent can therefore identify improvements beyond those demonstrated in the sampled rollouts. At the same time, a choice made by one successful solution does not automatically become a requirement for all others.
items.zh: 采样的 rollout 为评分标准的构建提供依据，但标准本身以任务为根基。一个有用的行为可能只出现在一次尝试中，而任务所支持的一项需求也可能在所有已观察到的解法中都不存在。因此，智能体能够识别出超出采样 rollout 所展示的改进。与此同时，某个成功解法所做的选择并不会自动成为所有其他解法的要求。

items.en: The resulting rubrics are reused to evaluate subsequent training rollouts individually. A grader agent enters each rollout's execution environment and assesses it against the task-specific rubrics, using the resulting code, execution results, and trajectory as evidence. It assigns a solution score \(S^{\mathrm{sol}}\) for the quality of the implementation and a behavior score \(S^{\mathrm{beh}}\) for how the agent approached and verified its work.
items.zh: 所得的评分标准被复用于对后续训练 rollout 逐一评估。一个评分智能体进入每条 rollout 的执行环境，并依据任务特定的评分标准对其进行评估，以最终代码、执行结果和轨迹作为证据。它为实现质量给出一个**解法分数** \(S^{\mathrm{sol}}\)，并为智能体如何着手与验证其工作给出一个**行为分数** \(S^{\mathrm{beh}}\)。

items.en: For trajectory \(i\), let \(R_{i}^{\mathrm{test}}\) denote the original binary test reward. We synthesize the final training reward by multiplying this test reward by the two rubric scores:
items.zh: 对于轨迹 \(i\)，令 \(R_{i}^{\mathrm{test}}\) 表示原始的二元测试奖励。我们通过将该测试奖励与两个评分标准分数相乘，来合成最终训练奖励：

items.en: This multiplicative form keeps rubric supervision tied to test outcomes. Failed trajectories retain zero reward, while passing trajectories are further distinguished by implementation quality and problem-solving behavior. Even when every rollout in a group passes the tests, differences in the product of the two rubric scores can still provide a learning signal. The offline task analysis thus becomes a reusable source of supervision, allowing training to capture quality differences that binary test rewards leave unexpressed.
items.zh: 这种乘法形式使评分细则监督与测试结果保持关联。失败的轨迹奖励保持为零，而通过的轨迹则依据实现质量和问题求解行为被进一步区分。即使一个组内的所有 rollout 都通过测试，两个评分细则分数乘积的差异仍能提供学习信号。因此，离线任务分析成为一种可复用的监督来源，使训练能够捕捉二元测试奖励未能表达的质量差异。

full.secZh: 4.3.2 分组优势重分配（GAR，在线评分）

items.en: We apply online groupwise advantage redistribution to the remaining code agent tasks. For each mixed-outcome rollout group, we place all trajectories in a shared workspace containing the task specification, repository, submitted patches, and test outputs. An SFT-trained agentic grader jointly examines all trajectories within the group, contrasting successful and failed attempts and comparing passing patches along five dimensions: the suitability of the solution approach, precision in implementing that approach without omissions or unnecessary fallbacks, minimality relative to the necessary changes, avoidance of unintended effects outside the task, and craftsmanship consistent with codebase conventions. These assessments guide the groupwise ranking, with ties when differences are inconclusive. The grader can inspect repository code and run targeted tests to better understand the task and verify candidate solutions. When evidence confirms dependence on an external or leaked answer, we reset the trajectory’s effective reward to zero and treat it as a failure before recomputing group statistics.
items.zh: 我们将在线分组优势重分配应用于剩余的代码智能体任务。对于每个混合结果的 rollout 组，我们将所有轨迹放入一个共享工作区，其中包含任务规范、代码仓库、提交的补丁和测试输出。一个经过 SFT 训练的智能体式评分器会联合检查组内的所有轨迹，对比成功和失败的尝试，并从五个维度比较通过的补丁：解决方案的适用性、实现该方案的精确性（无遗漏或不必要的回退）、相对于必要更改的最小性、避免任务之外的意外影响，以及与代码库约定一致的手艺。这些评估指导分组排名，当差异不确定时则并列。评分器可以检查仓库代码并运行针对性测试，以更好地理解任务并验证候选解决方案。当证据确认依赖于外部或泄露的答案时，我们将轨迹的有效奖励重置为零，并在重新计算组统计量之前将其视为失败。

items.en: We use the remaining quality rankings to redistribute sequence-level advantages. For trajectory \(i\), let \(R_{i}\) be the effective binary reward after hack correction, \(\bar{R}\) its group mean, \(A_{i}=R_{i}-\bar{R}\) its sequence-level advantage, and \(\mathcal{P}=\{i:R_{i}=1\}\). For nonempty \(\mathcal{P}\), quality factors \(f_{i}\in(0,1]\) first downweight lower-quality passes, after which a common factor redistributes the removed positive advantage mass among passing trajectories. The uncapped update is

items.en: This uncapped update preserves \(\sum_{i\in\mathcal{P}}A_{i}^{\prime}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{P}}A_{i}\) and the quality-induced relative weights without altering failed trajectories. In effect, it redistributes positive advantage mass from lower-quality to higher-quality successful trajectories. Simply downweighting positive advantages leaves negative advantages unchanged; renormalization restores their balance as a safeguard against excessive entropy growth. In practice, we cap the common rescaling factor to prevent excessive amplification of positive advantages. We then subtract the group mean from the advantages of both passing and failed trajectories, yielding final sequence advantages \(A_{i}^{\mathrm{new}}\) with zero group mean. We broadcast this sequence-level advantage to all response tokens in the trajectory. Grading runs asynchronously, with unusable grader outputs falling back to the original advantages.
items.zh: 这种未截断的更新保持了 \(\sum_{i\in\mathcal{P}}A_{i}^{\prime}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{P}}A_{i}\) 以及质量诱导的相对权重，而不改变失败的轨迹。实际上，它将正优势质量从低质量的成功轨迹重新分配给高质量的成功轨迹。简单地降低正优势的权重会使负优势保持不变；重新归一化恢复了它们的平衡，作为防止熵过度增长的保障。在实践中，我们对公共重缩放因子进行截断，以防止正优势的过度放大。然后，我们从通过和失败轨迹的优势中减去组均值，得到组均值为零的最终序列优势 \(A_{i}^{\mathrm{new}}\)。我们将这个序列级优势广播到轨迹中的所有响应 token。评分异步运行，不可用的评分器输出回退到原始优势。

items.en: To assess the effect of online groupwise advantage redistribution on training dynamics, we compare code-only RL runs of MiMo-V2.6-Flash with and without it, using a training batch size of 128 and token-mean loss aggregation (Figure 8). Without online grading, turns and total token length grow rapidly, causing more trajectories to hit the length limit, making it difficult to sustain improvements in pass rate. With online grading, pass-rate gains are sustained through step 52, while turn counts remain roughly stable and token length grows gradually. These trends suggest that online grading supports continued policy improvement under a more stable training regime.
items.zh: 为了评估在线分组优势重分配对训练动态的影响，我们比较了 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在仅代码 RL 运行中有无该方法的差异，使用训练批量大小为 128 和 token 均值损失聚合（图 8）。没有在线评分时，轮次和总 token 长度快速增长，导致更多轨迹达到长度限制，难以持续提高通过率。有在线评分时，通过率的提升持续到第 52 步，而轮次数保持大致稳定，token 长度逐渐增长。这些趋势表明，在线评分支持在更稳定的训练机制下持续进行策略改进。

items.en: Separate maintainer-oriented audits found that, under pressure to improve test pass rates, policies trained without online grading increasingly adopted undesirable behaviors such as speculative compatibility branches, broad exports, exception swallowing, relaxed validation, and evaluation-specific configuration changes. These workarounds aim to increase the likelihood of passing test but can exceed the scope of the task instructions, expand APIs unnecessarily, obscure failures, and make the code harder to maintain. In contrast, policies trained with online grading tended to produce smaller, more precise patches that remained within the requested scope and were easier to maintain.
items.zh: 独立的面向维护者的审计发现，在提高测试通过率的压力下，未经在线评分的策略越来越多地采用不良行为，如推测性兼容分支、广泛导出、异常吞没、放宽验证以及针对评估的配置更改。这些变通方法旨在增加通过测试的可能性，但可能超出任务指令的范围，不必要地扩展 API，掩盖失败，并使代码更难维护。相比之下，经过在线评分的策略倾向于产生更小、更精确的补丁，这些补丁保持在请求的范围内，并且更易于维护。

items.en: To improve RL training stability and encourage efficient, reliable behavior, we introduce two complementary mechanisms. A group-relative length penalty curbs excessive token growth, while segment-level behavioral penalties address format violations and tool call errors. Batch-level advantage rebalancing improves credit assignment while limiting excess negative optimization pressure that can drive uncontrolled entropy growth.
items.zh: 为提高强化学习训练的稳定性并鼓励高效、可靠的行为，我们引入两种互补机制。组相对长度惩罚抑制 token 的过度增长，而片段级行为惩罚处理格式违规与工具调用错误。批级优势重平衡改进信用分配，同时限制可能驱动熵失控增长的过度负向优化压力。
